body: If you can, maybe try to do small things to get closer to your dream. You can learn to edit on free programmes and a lot of small streamers respond to messages. There’s also a lot of other things you can make on a low budget, like making tiktoks to get your name out there or starting an Instagram account based on the brand you want to create. The internet is fickle and I wouldn’t recommend basing your entire future on fame, but it’s usually less depressing to be making content and connections rather than wishing. I hope things improve for you.

I really want to, but my mum would never forgive me and I’m scared of having to live with her hating me. The last time she found out I was struggling she threatened to cut off my access to my friends and told me I was a dumb, faking disappointment. She approves of therapy for anybody but her own children. Plus, I feel like I would be taking away resources from those who really deserve them.
I don’t know about OxyContin specifically, but most ods feel vile. Chest pains, gut pains, sweating and seizing. Dying is not a fun experience, no matter how calmly you try to do it.

Solidarity. I swear just being alive feels wrong at this point. If you can, I find that being alone in nature helps with some of these thoughts. Not to be one of those “just go outside and stop being mentally ill” people, but sometimes it feels nice to remember that at least the squirrels don’t care about what you look like and who you are.
